title: Photograph: a blessed letter of the Prophet (rotated page)

paras.en: Photograph of a blessed letter (the page is rotated; the caption is not legible).
paras.ur: نامۂ مبارک کا عکس (صفحہ گھما ہوا ہے؛ عنوان ناقابلِ مطالعہ ہے)۔
paras.ps: د مبارک لیک انځور (پاڼه ګرځول شوې ده؛ سرلیک نه لوستل کېږي).

sourceNote: Printed page 72: a rotated full-page photograph of an ancient letter with a round seal at the bottom of the text. The caption (which on a rotated page lies along the left edge) is cut off in the scan and cannot be read, so the caption line given here is only a neutral description by us and not printed text; the photograph itself is not reproduced. Needs checking against a better scan (the letter is probably the one to the ruler of the Roman empire or another king). English and Pashto are our translations (need native review); watermark, handwriting, page-edge shadows, a thumb at the page edge and ornamental borders excluded. Scan n = printed page n+1 (file = {p//2:03d}_page_2 for even printed page p, {(p-1)//2:03d}_page_1 for odd p).
